scenarios.title: Limit alarms and anomaly model against ESA labels
scenarios.setup: full OPS-SAT-AD dataset: 303493 samples, 2123 segments (434 labelled anomalous), clean link

checks.name: Limit alarms (MAG ±47/±52 µT, 3-sample confirmation)
checks.observed: precision 0.33 · recall 0.03 · F1 0.06 (TP 15 FP 31 FN 419 TN 1658)
checks.note: limits set from nominal training data; sun sensors have no limits (nominal data saturates at π/2)

checks.name: Anomaly model (spike / noise / flat / gap, unsupervised)
